title: Free university (mid-level)
question:
Some people believe that university education should be free for all students. Others think students should pay for their own studies.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Write at least 250 words.
essay:
Nowadays, education is very important for everyone. Some people think university should be free for all student, but other people think students must pay. In this essay I will discuss both side and give my opinion.

Firstly, there are many reason why university should be free. If university is free, more poor students can study and get a good job in future. For example in my country many young people can not go to university because there family dont have money. This is not fair for them. Also, the government will get benefit because educated people pay more tax when they work.

On the other hand, some people think students should pay for their studies. Because university cost a lot of money and government have to spend money in other things like hospital and roads. If students pay, they will study more hard because they dont want to waste there money. Moreover, not every people need to go university, some people can learn skill in work.

In my opinion, I think university should be free for poor students but rich students should pay. This way is more fair and government can save money. Also students will be more responsible.

In conclusion, there are advantages and disadvantages of free university. Both views have good points. I believe government should help poor students to study in university, so everyone have same chance in their life.
